newsitem.title: NICARAGUA: Seven policemen hurt in Nicaragua student clash.
newsitem.headline: Seven policemen hurt in Nicaragua student clash.

text.p: At least seven police officers were hurt in a clash with demonstrating university students in Nicaragua on Wednesday, officials said.
University students in Nicaragua have been protesting regularly since May 26 against a reduction in the government's education budget. About 170 people have been injured in street battles since then.
"A group that was nearing the end of a march started a battle with (homemade) mortars ... against police guarding the National Assembly," police captain Justo Zamora told a local radio station.
Earlier reports said five policemen were hurt, but a police spokesman said later that the number had risen to seven. At least three of the policemen were said to have been seriously injured.
